entries.title: PR #79: App Store readiness config, privacy manifest, runbook
entries.basis: Verified: file list and line counts read from GitHub; preview links from the PR comments. CI green is as reported by the thread.

entries.why: expo-doctor failed 17/18 on a key nothing reads, and the privacy manifest listed only location and diagnostics while the app also collects email, name, user id, purchase history, device id and gameplay content. App Review compares the manifest and your App Store Connect answers with the binary.

entries.title: Blocker found: website location wording
entries.basis: Verified by the thread against the live pages and app.json.
entries.summary: The live privacy policy and support page say location is foreground-only, but the app asks for Always location and background mode for auto check-in.
entries.why: App Review compares the policy with the binary. The website is not in the Expo repo, so only you can change it. Replacement wording is in the runbook.

entries.title: Priority change: gesture and navigation audit
entries.basis: Reported by the Expo UI thread from the coordinator's relay; no findings yet.
entries.summary: Reading the code for gesture and navigation bugs: the one Gesture.Pan site, PanResponders, sheets and drawers, Expo Router modal and sheet options, and nested scroll views. Each finding will get file:line, cause, standard fix, and verified or belief.
entries.why: You said the audit missed the real problems: swipes that dismiss the screen while scrolling, drawers that should not swipe, and bounce-back behavior. Screenshots and grep cannot find those.
